name: YouTube Live

maxWidth.note: Best 1440p60 or 4K60. Official page agrees (landscape max): https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/2853702

portrait.note: Fetched page text does not mention vertical/portrait. Landscape max is applied by long/short side, so 1080x1920 is judged against 3840x2160.

videoCodecs.note: H.264, HEVC, AV1 supported. Official page lists HEVC/AV1: https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/2853702

min.note: Table gives per-resolution minimums (e.g. 720p 3 Mbps, 1080p60 6 Mbps for the second column); global minimum not stated and column-to-codec mapping unconfirmed.

max.note: Highest recommended (2160p60 H.264). Official page agrees: https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/2853702

recommendedByResolution.note: H.264 recommended kbps per resolution. Official table (second column) agrees: https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/2853702

max.note: Hard max 4 s. Severity error because: YouTube encoder settings page: "Do not exceed 4 seconds" (recommended 2 s is a separate warning rule).

multitrackVideo.note: Not found in the fetched page.

max.note: Page gives 128 kbps stereo / 384 kbps 5.1 as recommendations, not caps.

recommended.note: AAC 128 kbps stereo is RECOMMENDED, not a max. Official page agrees: https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/2853702

audioTracksMax.note: Not found in the fetched page.

notes: Bitrates per resolution are recommendations; max is the 2160p60 recommendation. Audio values are recommended, not caps.

rateControl.message: YouTube lists CBR; VBR may cause buffering

recommended.note: AAC 44.1 kHz stereo, RECOMMENDED. Official page agrees: https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/2853702

replyMaxChars.note: UNVERIFIED. No official source: the liveChatMessages docs (checked 2026-10-28) state no messageText limit. 200 comes from the legacy Streamer.bot README ("YouTube live chat cuts off at 200"), an observation, not documentation.
